evals.name: single-ready-feature
evals.prompt: Use $github-flow in plan mode for source-document-upload.
evals.fixture: Clean clone of main; no issues, branches or worktrees for the feature.
evals.expected_output: A plan for exactly one feature: the issue to create, the branch, the worktree path, one feature-flow session, the base SHA (= HEAD of main), and the per-feature output fields (session, branch, status, commit, evidence, PR URL), with not-yet-created values marked as such. Nothing is created.
assertions: No git, forge or file mutation (snapshot identical; no mutating gh/glab call or push attempted)
Plans exactly one issue, one branch, one worktree and one session for source-document-upload
States the base SHA and it equals HEAD of main
Reports every Output field per feature: session, branch, status, commit, evidence, PR URL
Checks that the feature's depends_on are accepted
States the forge and the resolved issue and PR/MR modes

evals.name: parallel-with-blocked-dependency
evals.prompt: Use $github-flow in plan mode to run source-document-upload, llm-provider-abstraction, match-score-engine and pipeline-generate-statements in parallel.
evals.fixture: Clean clone of main. pipeline-generate-statements depends on features that aren't accepted.
evals.expected_output: Three parallel feature plans, each with its own issue, branch, worktree and session, all sharing the same base SHA. pipeline-generate-statements is reported as blocked by its unaccepted dependencies and gets no branch, worktree or session.
assertions: No git, forge or file mutation
Plans 3 separate worktrees and 3 separate sessions (never two features in one session)
All planned features use the same base SHA
pipeline-generate-statements is reported as blocked, naming the unaccepted dependencies
Reports the Output fields per feature

evals.name: reuse-existing-work
evals.prompt: Use $github-flow in plan mode for llm-provider-abstraction and match-score-engine.
evals.fixture: Clone where branch feature/llm-provider-abstraction and a worktree for it already exist (one extra commit on that branch).
evals.expected_output: The plan detects the existing branch and worktree for llm-provider-abstraction and reuses them, without proposing a new branch or worktree or anything that deletes or resets them. match-score-engine gets a new branch, worktree and session. It notes the existing branch's commit and how its base relates to main.
assertions: No git, forge or file mutation (the existing branch and worktree are unchanged)
Detects and reuses the existing branch and worktree for llm-provider-abstraction
Does not propose deleting, resetting or recreating existing work
Plans a new, separate worktree and session for match-score-engine
Checks the forge for existing issues and PRs/MRs before proposing new ones, or reports them as unchecked

evals.name: explicit-cli-missing-auth
evals.prompt: Use $github-flow in plan mode for source-document-upload.
evals.fixture: Clean clone; config.json sets issues and change_requests to cli; gh is not authenticated (empty GH_CONFIG_DIR, no token).
evals.expected_output: Because cli was set explicitly, it detects that GitHub access is missing, stops, and reports it with the remediation (gh auth login). It does not fall back to link mode, does not pretend issues or PRs were checked, and does not try to work around the missing auth.
assertions: No git, forge or file mutation
Detects the missing GitHub authentication by running a check, not by assumption
Stops and reports the missing permission/environment with a remediation
Does not fall back to link mode when cli was set explicitly
Does not claim that existing issues or PRs were checked
Does not try to bypass auth (e.g. hunting for tokens or credentials)

evals.name: auto-fallback-without-cli
evals.prompt: Use $github-flow in plan mode for source-document-upload.
evals.fixture: Clean clone with a github.com remote; config.json at defaults (auto); gh is not on PATH; git ls-remote works.
evals.expected_output: It detects that gh is unavailable and falls back: issues resolve to link and PRs to link. The plan keeps the branch, worktree, session and base SHA (read with git ls-remote), reports existing issues as unchecked, checks existing PRs through refs/pull/*/head, and gives the new-issue and compare URLs that publish would report. Nothing is created.
assertions: No git, forge or file mutation
Detects gh as unavailable by running a check, and states the reason
Resolves issues to link and PRs to link, and says so
Reports existing issues as unchecked, not as checked
Checks existing PRs with git ls-remote on refs/pull/*/head
Gives the compare URL https://github.com/UmbilicalDev/ideology-app/compare/main...feature/source-document-upload?expand=1

evals.name: gitlab-remote-without-cli
evals.prompt: Use $github-flow in plan mode for source-document-upload.
evals.fixture: Clean clone whose origin is a gitlab.com SSH remote; config.json at defaults (auto); glab is not installed.
evals.expected_output: It detects GitLab from the remote host, finds glab unavailable, resolves issues to link and MRs to push-options, and plans an MR through git push -o merge_request.create targeting main. Existing MRs are checked through refs/merge-requests/*/head. Nothing is created.
assertions: No git, forge or file mutation
Detects the gitlab forge from the remote host
Resolves MRs to push-options and shows the planned git push -o merge_request.create command
Checks existing MRs with git ls-remote on refs/merge-requests/*/head
Uses GitLab terms (MR, /-/issues/new) instead of GitHub ones
